mapper.sql: SELECT #{targetReport} AS TAGT_TYPE , REPORT.REPT_NUMB AS TAGT_NUMB FROM TM_REPORT REPORT WHERE REPORT.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND NOT (REPORT.PUBC_YSNO = #{commNo} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_CLPART PART WHERE PART.REPT_NUMB = REPORT.REPT_NUMB)) UNION ALL SELECT #{targetProfile} AS TAGT_TYPE , OWNER.PROF_NUMB AS TAGT_NUMB FROM TM_USERXM OWNER WHERE OWNER.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} UNION ALL SELECT #{targetBackground} AS TAGT_TYPE , OWNER.BGIM_NUMB AS TAGT_NUMB FROM TM_USERXM OWNER WHERE OWNER.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}
mapper.delete: DELETE /* delBlockLikes */ L FROM TB_LIKEXX L LEFT JOIN TB_REPLXX R ON L.TAGT_TYPE = #{targetReply} AND R.REPL_NUMB = L.TAGT_NUMB LEFT JOIN TB_REPLXX P ON P.REPL_NUMB = R.UPER_NUMB LEFT JOIN () OWNED ON OWNED.TAGT_TYPE = COALESCE(R.TAGT_TYPE, L.TAGT_TYPE) AND OWNED.TAGT_NUMB = COALESCE(R.TAGT_NUMB, L.TAGT_NUMB) WHERE (L.USER_NUMB = #{blocNumb} AND (OWNED.TAGT_NUMB IS NOT NULL OR (R.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND R.TAGT_TYPE IN (#{targetReport}, #{targetProfile}, #{targetBackground}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TM_REPORT REPORT JOIN TB_CLPART PART ON PART.REPT_NUMB = REPORT.REPT_NUMB WHERE R.TAGT_TYPE = #{targetReport} AND REPORT.REPT_NUMB = R.TAGT_NUMB AND REPORT.PUBC_YSNO = #{commNo} )))) OR ()
mapper.update: UPDATE /* delBlockReplies */ TB_REPLXX R LEFT JOIN TB_REPLXX P ON P.REPL_NUMB = R.UPER_NUMB LEFT JOIN () OWNED ON OWNED.TAGT_TYPE = R.TAGT_TYPE AND OWNED.TAGT_NUMB = R.TAGT_NUMB SET R.REPL_CNTN = NULL , R.DELT_YSNO = #{commYes} , R.UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE
mapper.select: SELECT /* lockUsers */ USER_NUMB FROM TM_USERXM WHERE USER_NUMB IN (#{firstUserNumb}, #{secondUserNumb}) ORDER BY USER_NUMB FOR UPDATE
SELECT /* getBlockCnt */ COUNT(*) FROM TB_USBLOC WHERE (USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND BLOC_NUMB = #{targetUserNumb}) OR (USER_NUMB = #{targetUserNumb} AND BLOC_NUMB = #{userNumb})
mapper.delete: DELETE /* delBlockFollows */ FROM TB_FOLLOW WHERE (USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND FLOW_NUMB = #{blocNumb}) OR (USER_NUMB = #{blocNumb} AND FLOW_NUMB = #{userNumb})

DELETE /* delBlockApplications */ APPLICATION FROM TB_CLJOIN APPLICATION INNER JOIN TM_CLUBXM CLUB ON CLUB.CLUB_NUMB = APPLICATION.CLUB_NUMB WHERE APPLICATION.JOIN_STAT = #{applicationPending} AND ( (CLUB.OWNR_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND APPLICATION.USER_NUMB = #{blocNumb}) OR (CLUB.OWNR_NUMB = #{blocNumb} AND APPLICATION.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}) )
mapper.select: SELECT /* getBlockList */ B.BLOC_NUMB , CASE WHEN U.USER_STAT = #{userStatActive} THEN U.USER_NICK ELSE NULL END AS USER_NICK , U.USER_STAT_NAME , B.REGI_DATE FROM TB_USBLOC B INNER JOIN ( SELECT U.USER_NUMB , U.USER_NICK , U.USER_STAT , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{codeUserStat}, U.USER_STAT, NULL, #{languageCode}) AS USER_STAT_NAME FROM TM_USERXM U ) U ON U.USER_NUMB = B.BLOC_NUMB WHERE B.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} ORDER BY B.REGI_DATE DESC , B.BLOC_NUMB DESC LIMIT #{pageOffset}, #{pageLimit}
